summary: Independently validated GREEN 2b3080d6 against RED c1e443fc and both plan commits in the clean detached checkout. RED is genuinely causal: the frozen RED test (source hash 295515e5... matches plan) opened a genuine first-transition fixture, observed the retained one-call commit perform exactly one old-to-new swap, proved both subpaths absent, and failed only with D110C_0B0A_STAGED_HANDOFF_SEAM_MISSING (vitest.json success:false, 1 failed, hash db4dcd... matches plan). GREEN closes exactly that seam: @ts-drp/node/creator-adoption-stage exports exactly stageCreatorSuccessorAdoption/publishStagedCreatorSuccessorAdoption and creator-adoption-recover exports exactly recoverPendingCreatorSuccessorAdoption; package.json adds only those two non-root subpaths and both exact export-map snapshots in tests/phase-3a1b-p3-live-transport-red.test.ts were updated in matching key order. Stage writes/authenticates the Complete generation with zero swapHead and head byte-identical, performs no provider I/O or activation, and mints a distinct WeakMap-custody, owner-bound, destructively-consumed opaque capability rejected cross-owner (commit/activate), cross-handle, cloned, replayed, and mutated. Publish performs exactly one old-to-new CAS and resolves ambiguous commit-then-throw outcomes solely by authenticated reopen, never assuming success. Recovery takes the copied exact previous/next room-head tuples only from input, authenticates pinned genesis, predecessor/successor trust, cut/QC, snapshot/manifest/catalog/projection/ACL, never derives tuples from AHE bytes, never activates, selects the lexicographically smallest encoded generation ID among equivalent same-closure Complete retries while old, matches already-new via authenticated successor trust, and fails closed (pending-missing/true-fork/stale-head/chain-invalid/malformed-input). The retained commit kernel's one-call/fault semantics are preserved through the stage/publish split (swap moved to publishCandidate with identical ambiguous-outcome reopen behavior); commit export roster, root exports, protocol/wire, dependencies, thresholds, and product orchestration are untouched (diff roster confined to the 16 declared paths). All 12 source hashes, focused/retained report hashes, ledger hash, and plan hash match the self-excluding 16-entry manifest byte-for-byte; focused.json is genuinely 3/3 and retained.json genuinely 86/86, 14 suites, success:true; both commits carry valid signatures (%G?=G), the branch ref exists on the remote, 27 stashes including the named exploratory stash are present, the tree is clean, and git diff --check passes. Tests are causal and adversarial: genuine stored Complete generations, exact swap counts, after-request throw on swapHead exercising the ambiguous reread, both old/new recovery orderings, equivalent retries, a genuine different-closure fork candidate installed through the real AHE backend, and non-activation proven via the activation owner rejecting the staged capability.

findings.title: Retained ledger/plan prose claims eight selected files; retained.json contains seven result files
findings.evidence: .logs/d110c-0b0a-green-c1e443fc/green-ledger.md lines 18-31 and plan v2 lines 93001-93002 claim the retained command selected eight files including tests/phase-6b-d110c-0b0a-staged-handoff-red.test.ts, but retained.json (hash-verified) has exactly 7 testResults entries totaling 86 tests/14 suites; the staged-handoff file's 3 tests are covered only by focused.json. The 86/86 and 14-suite numbers are internally consistent with the seven files actually present, so no result is inflated and no gate is weakened.
findings.required_action: Owner: evidence-ledger wording. Disposition: correct the ledger and plan prose to 'seven files' (or rerun retained including the focused file); no code change, no re-review required.
